_comment: Operator-confirmed curation directives applied by build_registry.py AFTER the seed loads and BEFORE/AFTER the source merge. Keeps the seed file pristine (seed carries only betanyc_org_legacy identifiers; test_no_fabricated_verified_identifiers_in_seed) while recording operator-confirmed merges and name-variant additions in one auditable place. Source of authority: PR #5 entity-resolution guidance comment (operator: Noel, 2026-07-15). See docs/sources.md and the Phase 2 journal.
